standard: Field Assembly Record Standard 1.2, §8 market records; see PROVENANCE.md
notes: Numbers computed from run 2026-10-18T144903Z, recomputed 2026-10-18 after the observation record's 2026-10-01 pass was recovered. The BLS PPI and CPI series carry September 2026. Prose not yet written. tools/check.py passes for this issue. Correction recorded here because it changed the computed set: the 2026-10-01 observation pass had captured all eight sellers, but the parse produced rows for one of them. A seller behind a bot check served an HTML captcha interstitial with a 200 to its product endpoint, the parser called json.loads on it, and the resulting JSONDecodeError was not a ParseFailure, so it ended the pass instead of failing that source. The six sellers after it in source order were never parsed, two of which had captured cleanly. lobster/observations/tools/parse.py now fails a source rather than the pass, records a body that is not JSON as PARSE_FAILED and an unforeseen exception as PARSER_ERROR, and the retained captures were re-parsed. The month now holds both capture dates, 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-15, and the 2026-10-01 outcome of every seller is explicit in data/flags.jsonl: two parsed, two PARSE_FAILED, and four FAILED_CAPTURE from one HTTP 403 and three HTTP 429. Those four were lost at capture and are not recoverable from the retained response; the products they cover are marked unavailable for that date rather than omitted. Remaining gaps: of the eight sellers observed, two carry the reference series of a single live hard-shell 1.25 lb lobster, so the consumer reference rests on sellers D and G. Seller G is observed on both capture dates and did not move; seller D is observed on 2026-10-15 only. The consumer reference carries no year-over-year comparison: the Field Assembly observation record begins 2026-09-26. The NOAA import figures are for 2026-08, the newest month that series publishes, and the record holds no 2024-08 reading, so neither import measure carries a two-year comparison. The Maine DMR September ex-vessel figure is 2025 and preliminary. The USDA ERS Food Price Outlook year-over-year attribute is August 2025 to August 2026, not September.
